question: How should the preferences of younger investors shape Edward Jones's offerings?

cells.label: different_quantity

items.text: Schwab describes its retail business as built to win across investing styles including self-directed to advised, and engagement preferences from digital-first to relationship-led.
items.quote:
Investing Styles Self-directed to advised 3

Digital-first to relationship-led Engagement Preferences 4

items.text: Schwab states it is meeting younger investors in the channels where they turn for information about investing, and that they learn about finances primarily through social media and family.
items.quote: One of the reasons they're turning to Schwab is because we're meeting them in the channels where they turn for information about investing. We know they learn about finances primarily through social media and family.

items.text: Schwab states younger traders are turning to Schwab because they recognize the potential that trading has in helping build wealth over time.
items.quote: Younger traders are turning to us because they recognize the potential that trading has in helping build wealth over time.

items.text: Schwab states their top online resource is YouTube, and Schwab is the number one financial services firm on YouTube by followers.
items.quote: Their top online resource is YouTube, and we're the number one financial services firm on YouTube by followers.

items.text: Schwab states younger investors are highly engaged in building their wealth over the long term, with one-third of retail households who created a financial plan within the last two years under the age of 40.
items.quote: younger investors at Schwab are highly engaged in building their wealth over the long term. In fact, one-third of retail households who created a financial plan within the last two years are under the age of 40.
items.unit: retail households under age 40 who created a financial plan
items.scope: retail households creating a financial plan within the last two years

items.text: Schwab lists offerings for younger investors including Schwab Starter Kit, Schwab Teen Investor Account, and no/low commissions.
items.quote: Younger investors | Schwab Starter Kit TM | Schwab Teen Investor TM Account | No / low commissions

items.text: Schwab states younger investors seek advice on topics like paying off college debt and buying a house, and that Schwab has in-person experiences in over 400 locations and 16,000 advisors.
items.quote: For serious investors who want to, young investors who want to think about how to pay off their college debt, how to buy a house, there's no better place to be than here at Schwab.

cells.differs_because: The passages describe Schwab's offering of the full spectrum of self-directed to advised models and engagement preferences, and how younger investors are reached and what they seek, but do not state a specific preference for self-directed versus full-service advice and service models among younger investors as such.
cells.reason: No passage states a clear preference by younger investors for self-directed versus full-service models; passages instead describe engagement channels and tools, which are related but not the asked quantity.
